bass_purpose.text: Studies ignition, spread and extinction of solid fuels in slow forced airflow.
bass_purpose.context: ISS microgravity; catalog objective, not a result

bass_sample.text: Solid samples include rods, slabs, films, fabrics and spherical sections.
bass_sample.context: Catalog geometries; not a single test matrix

bass_oxygen.text: Oxygen is reduced below 21% by adding nitrogen.
bass_oxygen.context: Catalog approach; not a measured range across downloaded runs

quantity.unit: % oxygen; concentration basis not specified in reviewed text

bass_flow.context: Apparatus capability; not the airflow used in every test

bass_sensors.text: CSA-CP readings cover oxygen and carbon monoxide; CDM readings cover carbon dioxide.
bass_sensors.context: Before and after BASS-II tests; reported sensor use

bass_measure.text: Gas readings and burn times were used to estimate heat release.
bass_measure.context: Paper analysis; raw sensor series not reviewed

bass_result.text: The paper reports heat release below 100 W for the majority of its tests.
bass_result.context: Not a maximum, safety threshold, or claim about every BASS-II run

same_purpose.text: Measures smoke particle sizes and how generation and transport conditions affect them.
same_purpose.context: ISS reflight; purpose stated in catalog

same_instrument.text: The reflight added an M-pass instrument and changed heating and flow conditions.
same_instrument.context: SAME-R modifications; do not copy the original SAME sensor list

same_sample.text: Teflon, Kapton, cotton, silicone rubber and Pyrell were heated below ignition.
same_sample.context: SAME-2 reflight, Expedition 24, July–September 2010; smoke production rather than open-flame spread

same_flow.text: Airflow during sample heating ranged from still air to 8 cm/s.

same_sensor.text: Diagnostics included a prototype two-moment smoke detector and TEM-grid samples for post-flight analysis.
same_sensor.context: Particle measurements, not a certified detector performance test

same_measure.text: Particle number, diameter and mass moments were measured.
same_measure.context: Distribution diagnostics; some derived sizes assume a log-normal distribution

same_time2012.text: The 2012 abstract reports an effective smoke transport time of 11–1800 s.
same_time2012.context: Aging chamber holding times in this publication

same_result.text: Most average smoke particle sizes were 200–400 nm; some still-air cases were larger.
same_result.context: Reported averages for these test conditions; not all particles or all spacecraft smoke

same_time2013.text: The 2013 abstract reports effective smoke transport times of 11–800 s.
same_time2013.context: Retained separately from the 2012 paper; discrepancy not resolved

same_detection.text: The authors relate the smoke measurements to design requirements for future spacecraft smoke detectors.
same_detection.context: Design evidence, not detector certification or a recommended alarm threshold

flex_purpose.text: Investigates liquid-fuel flammability limits and the effectiveness of gaseous suppressants.
flex_purpose.context: ISS microgravity; objective rather than demonstrated performance

flex_sample.text: Liquid fuel droplets; specific fuel composition is not extracted here.
flex_sample.context: Fuel-specific results require the underlying test records

flex_pressure.text: The described procedure selects pressure between 0.5 and 1.5 atm.
flex_pressure.context: Procedure range; not confirmed run coverage

flex_measure.text: Planned measurements include droplet burning, extinction, radiation, soot and temperature.
flex_measure.context: Measurement goals; no numerical outcome extracted

flex_suppress.text: Carbon dioxide, helium and sulfur hexafluoride are listed as gaseous suppressants to study.
flex_suppress.context: Not a recommended cabin suppressant, dose or exposure limit

saffire_purpose.text: Studies material flammability in an uncrewed Cygnus vehicle after it leaves the station.
saffire_purpose.locator: PDF page 1, introduction and Saffire-II section

saffire_sample.text: The sample set includes cotton/fiberglass, Nomex and acrylic glass.
saffire_sample.context: Not all materials were tested under one identical condition

saffire_geometry.text: This paper studies flame spread over 10 mm thick PMMA.
saffire_geometry.context: Specific thick-slab comparison; not the entire Saffire-II campaign

saffire_pressure.text: The Saffire-II microgravity comparison was at 100 kPa.

saffire_flow.text: Airflow in the Saffire-II PMMA comparison was 200 mm/s.
saffire_flow.context: Concurrent flame spread; same stated forced-flow speed in ground comparison

saffire_measure.text: The study compares concurrent flame spread over PMMA between ground and microgravity tests.
saffire_measure.context: No raw flame-spread time series included

saffire_result.text: Reducing ground-test pressure slowed flame spread toward the microgravity result.
saffire_result.context: Material- and method-specific result; not a universal gravity conversion

gravity_limit.text: Microgravity findings alone cannot certify fire safety on the Moon or Mars.
gravity_limit.context: Team/AI scope judgment: partial gravity requires its own validation; FM2 motivates dedicated lunar tests
